# Molecular Docking and GROMACS **English** · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) A reproducible workflow for soluble protein–ligand docking and molecular dynamics. Use dedicated modeling for membrane systems, covalent ligands, essential metals or cofactors, and nonstandard residues. The public 1IEP example uses a defined **+1** ligand microstate. | Intended use | Requires a specialized protocol | | --- | --- | | Graduate students and researchers using Bash to reproduce soluble protein–ligand docking, MD, or figures | Membrane assemblies, covalently bound ligands, essential metals or cofactors, and nonstandard residues with unverified parameters | [FAQ](docs/FAQ.md) · [Version matrix](docs/QUICKSTART.md#version-matrix) · [Validation boundary](docs/QUICKSTART.md#validation-boundary) **Verification:** 2026-11-28 public 1IEP Linux x86-64 CPU run. The documentation and executable commands correspond to the same source commit. ## Contact - [Issues](https://github.com/LuciferBioLab/docking-gromacs-tutorial/issues/new/choose) - [lucifer.qsq@gmail.com](mailto:lucifer.qsq@gmail.com) - [3069326069@qq.com](mailto:3069326069@qq.com) ![Docking-to-dynamics cover](assets/workflow-cover.webp) **Checked pose handoff.** Preserve the source ligand chemistry. Recover the docking coordinates with Meeko metadata or an explicit RDKit atom map. [Two handoff routes](docs/DOCKING.md#pose-handoff) · [Chem3D/PyMOL comparison](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md#chem3d-pymol-topology). ## Start here 1. **Dock only:** complete steps 01–05 using the checksummed 1IEP files. [Quickstart](docs/QUICKSTART.md#dock). 2. **Run MD:** use a reviewed docking pose or a complete prepared system. [System setup](docs/SYSTEM_SETUP.md#topology) · [Quickstart](docs/QUICKSTART.md#quickstart-md). 3. **Make figures:** start with a matching trajectory, topology and index. [Analysis](docs/ANALYSIS.md#analysis). ![Three workflow entry points](assets/entry-map.png) ## Contents - [Quickstart](docs/QUICKSTART.md) - [File map and run checklist](docs/WORKFLOW.md) - [01–02 Environment and redocking](docs/ENVIRONMENT.md) - [03–05 Preparation and docking](docs/DOCKING.md) - [06–08 Force fields and setup](docs/SYSTEM_SETUP.md) - [09–10 Equilibration and production](docs/SIMULATION.md) - [11–12 Analysis and records](docs/ANALYSIS.md) - [Glossary and command flags](docs/GLOSSARY.md) - [Research extensions and validation](docs/RESEARCH.md) - [Docking validation](docs/DOCKING_VALIDATION.md) - [Troubleshooting and tutorial corrections](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md) - [References and citation](docs/REFERENCES.md) 1. # 分子对接与 GROMACS 分子动力学 [English](README.md) · **简体中文** 面向可溶性蛋白–配体体系的可复现分子对接与分子动力学工作流。膜体系、共价配体、必需金属或辅因子、非标准残基需采用专用建模方案。公开 1IEP 示例采用已确定的 **+1** 配体微观状态。 | 适用 | 需要专用方案 | | --- | --- | | 使用 Bash 复现可溶性蛋白–配体对接、MD 或制图的研究者与学习者 | 膜组装、共价配体、必需金属或辅因子，以及参数尚未核查的非标准残基 | [常见问题](docs/FAQ.zh-CN.md) · [版本矩阵](docs/QUICKSTART.zh-CN.md#version-matrix) · [验证范围](docs/QUICKSTART.zh-CN.md#validation-boundary) **验证记录：** 2026-11-28，公开 1IEP 数据，Linux x86-64 CPU 路线。文档与可执行命令对应同一源码提交。 ## 联系 - [问题反馈](https://github.com/LuciferBioLab/docking-gromacs-tutorial/issues/new/choose) - [lucifer.qsq@gmail.com](mailto:lucifer.qsq@gmail.com) - [3069326069@qq.com](mailto:3069326069@qq.com) ![从分子对接到分子动力学](assets/workflow-cover.zh-CN.webp) **核验 docking pose（对接位姿）交接。** 保留原始配体化学身份，通过 Meeko 元数据或 RDKit 显式原子映射回填对接坐标。[两套交接路线](docs/DOCKING.zh-CN.md#pose-handoff) · [Chem3D/PyMOL 对照](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.zh-CN.md#chem3d-pymol-topology)。 ## 从这里开始 1. **只做对接：** 使用 SHA-256 校验过的 1IEP 输入完成 01–05。[快速入门](docs/QUICKSTART.zh-CN.md#dock)。 2. **只做 MD：** 使用已核验的 docking pose（对接位姿）或已建系输入。[体系准备](docs/SYSTEM_SETUP.zh-CN.md#topology) · [快速入门](docs/QUICKSTART.zh-CN.md#quickstart-md)。 3. **只想出图：** 准备相互匹配的轨迹、topology（拓扑）和索引。[分析](docs/ANALYSIS.zh-CN.md#analysis)。 ![三条入门路线](assets/entry-map.zh-CN.png) ## 目录 - [快速入门](docs/QUICKSTART.zh-CN.md) - [文件地图与运行核查表](docs/WORKFLOW.zh-CN.md) - [01–02 环境与重对接](docs/ENVIRONMENT.zh-CN.md) - [03–05 制备与对接](docs/DOCKING.zh-CN.md) - [06–08 力场与建系](docs/SYSTEM_SETUP.zh-CN.md) - [09–10 平衡与生产](docs/SIMULATION.zh-CN.md) - [11–12 分析与复现记录](docs/ANALYSIS.zh-CN.md) - [术语与命令参数](docs/GLOSSARY.zh-CN.md) - [研究扩展与验证](docs/RESEARCH.zh-CN.md) - [多阶段对接验证](docs/DOCKING_VALIDATION.zh-CN.md) - [排错与教程纠错](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.zh-CN.md) - [参考文献与引用](docs/REFERENCES.zh-CN.md) 1.
